title: Norm construction with cusp and elliptic order bounds
statement: Let N be a nonzero natural number and f a nonzero element of CuspForm (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 N) 2, with the subgroup interpreted through its real matrix image. Put μ=∑_{d∣N, d squarefree}N/d, c=∑_{d∣N}φ(gcd(d,N/d)), e₂=#{x∈ℤ/Nℤ:x²+1=0}, e₃=#{x∈ℤ/Nℤ:x²+x+1=0}, and ρ=(−1+i√3)/2. There exist F,A:ℂ→ℂ such that F is holomorphic and has a nonzero value on ℍ={z:Im z>0}; F(z+1)=F(z) and F(−1/z)=z^{2μ}F(z) on ℍ; A is analytic at zero; F(z)=A(exp(2πiz)) above some real height; and analyticOrderNatAt A 0≥c, analyticOrderNatAt F i≥e₂, and analyticOrderNatAt F ρ≥2e₃.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (f : CuspForm (CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0 N) 2), f ≠ 0 → ∃ F A : ℂ → ℂ, DifferentiableOn ℂ F {z : ℂ | 0 < z.im} ∧ (∃ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im ∧ F z ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → F (z + 1) = F z) ∧ (∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → F (-1 / z) = z ^ (2 * ModularCurve.dedekindPsi N) * F z) ∧ AnalyticAt ℂ A 0 ∧ (∃ Y : ℝ, ∀ z : ℂ, 0 < z.im → Y ≤ z.im → F z = A (Complex.exp (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I * z))) ∧ ModularCurve.cuspCount N ≤ analyticOrderNatAt A 0 ∧ ModularCurve.nuTwo N ≤ analyticOrderNatAt F Complex.I ∧ 2 * ModularCurve.nuThree N ≤ analyticOrderNatAt F ((-1 + (Real.sqrt 3 : ℂ) * Complex.I) / 2)
